author: Bobby Grayson
description: Chosen because findings overlap files across domains (query.rs, main.rs, db.rs) making independent PRs conflict-prone, while a mega-PR is unreviewable. Merge order: 1) CI+lint hygiene, 2) repo hygiene/dead-weight removal, 3) rust-core bug fixes+tests, 4) MCP server fixes+tests, 5) duplication refactor, 6) web viewer fixes+rebuilt embeds, 7) integration tests+docs. No features change, no version bump.
title: Ship a 7-PR stacked series of behavior-preserving fixes
